content.introduction: This week's economic calendar features several key labor market reports. On Tuesday, November 3, the Job Openings & Labor Turnover Survey and Factory Orders are scheduled for release at 10:00 AM ET. On Wednesday, November 4, the ADP National Employment Report is set for release at 8:15 AM ET, focusing on private sector jobs. The most anticipated report, the Employment Situation for October, is scheduled for release on Friday, November 6, at 8:30 AM ET. These reports will provide insights into the labor market dynamics and economic health.
body:
"We estimate that nonfarm payroll employment grew 50,000 in October, following gains in August (+133,000) and September (+29,000)," writes Barclays Chief U.S. Economist Marc Giannoni in a preview of incoming Jobs Friday data.

According to Giannoni's math, his headline forecast would work out to a three-month moving average of 71,000 new jobs, ahead of the 28,000 pace for the three months through July. [...] Kiplinger

# What to Look Out for in Economic Data This Week (November 2-6)

A steady stream of labor market data builds toward Jobs Friday on this week's economic calendar.

Image 12: Karee Venema

 By Karee Venema Edited by David Dittman [...] sees no signs of instability in the workforce or the unemployment rate.

Read on to see the entire weekly economic calendar of the most important upcoming economic reports scheduled to be released in the next several days. At times, we provide expanded previews and recaps for select reports.

Please check back often. This economic calendar is updated regularly. Bolded reports are those considered more noteworthy. All reporting times are in Eastern Time.
